evidence: bare_number_card: seg3:start to seg3:end and seg4 show two teal circles, each labelled "127%" and "Billionaire wealth". That is a number on a blob, and the S&P 500's 195% never appears even though the narration says it.

weakest_scene.visible_evidence: Two identical teal circles, both labelled "127%" and "Billionaire wealth" (seg3:start, seg3:mid, seg3:end). The narration says "the S&P 500 alone grew 195 percent", but no 195 and no S&P label appear on screen.
weakest_scene.root_cause: The comparison composer filled both sides from the same series. The stock-market side never got its own value or label, so the video's punchline ends up contradicting itself.
weakest_scene.repair_goal: Show billionaire wealth at +127% beside the S&P 500 at +195% as a physical comparison. For example, two stacks of money or two rising stock tickers where the S&P stack visibly towers over the billionaire one, with Data stacking the bricks or pumping the S&P stack up. Each side needs its own correct label and value.
